Several HSPH, GSE and GSAS pages state a deadline without a year (e.g. HSPH 'December 1') and those deadlines are left out. HSPH programmes with a 45- and a 65-credit variant appear as two entries sharing one URL. Skipped: GSAS AM in Medical Anthropology (admissions paused for fall 2027), Ed.L.D. (applications paused), the Extension School, MS/MBA and other joint or concurrent degrees, HSPH SM-42.5 variants (for doctoral-level research professionals), PhD and doctoral programmes. GSD TOEFL minimums are stated in a flattened table on the international page; GSD, GSE and HBS publish preferred or discouraging scores in addition to minimums.
